messages:
Sarah (People Ops): Quick thread — we have a new manager starting next Monday (Anika). I put together a compact 'first 5 days' setup sprint for managers. Please skim and add any infra/tech access steps we miss. TL;DR below. :sparkles:
Anika Patel: Thanks! Quick q: do I get laptop day 0? who handles Okta/email/KMS/GitHub access?
Marcus (IT): If procurement ticket is in by Wed we can hand laptop on day 0. For access: Okta + GSuite invite -> I handle. Infra creds need manager approval. Submit a ticket with the template below.
Marcus (IT): ```Title: New manager - laptop + access
Body:
- Name: Anika Patel
- Team: Eng - Platform
- Device: Macbook Pro 14 (or existing)
- Needs: Okta, GSuite, GitHub org access, AWS (staging read/write), KMS ops-view
- Manager: Samir K.
- Start date: 2026-04-06
```
Marcus (IT): If you already have a corporate device, reply here and we'll skip procurement. For AWS/KMS you'll need to complete the infra access form and get Samir's approval (we track in PR #infra-access).
Tom Lee: I'll book 30m 1:1 on day 1 and a team intro slot day 2. Plan: day1: access verification + 1:1; day2: team demos + infra walk; day3-5: shadowing + tiny ownership task. Also please share a draft 30/60/90 by EOD Friday so we can sync.
Priya (People Ops): Lean 30/60/90 template (internal): *30d*: onboarding, read docs, meet TLs, pair on an issue; *60d*: own a small feature, lead one retrospective; *90d*: deliver a measurable outcome + feedback loop. Link: <internal-docs/new-manager-30-60-90> Optional: copy this and tag your manager.
Samir K.: Expectations from my side: get codebase access day 1, triage backlog with TLs in week 1, pair with product for roadmap context. We'll set OKRs in week 2. For anything infra-related include budget owner on requests.
ops-bot: Calendar: "Manager Orientation - Day 0" created and invited: anika.patel@redwood.com — check your calendar.
Anika Patel: Can I get a buddy? Prefer someone senior on infra/platform to shadow first week.
Sarah (People Ops): Assigning buddy -> Tom Lee for first week onboarding (platform intro + infra contacts). I'll DM Tom to confirm. :white_check_mark:
Marcus (IT): Okta invite sent to anika.patel@redwood.com — follow the enrollment link and enroll MFA. If device enrollment fails, ping me and include a screenshot.
Anika Patel: Got the invite, MFA went through. One more Q: for demo environments (Dedicated/private) how do I request staging capacity short-term?
Tom Lee: File a service request in #eng-infra with these fields: use-case, region, expected concurrency, retention. Or ping me and I can fast-track small demo pools.
Samir K.: Also: take 1 hour to read the runbooks in /docs/oncall and our architecture overview. It cuts down follow-ups later.
Anika Patel: Awesome, thanks everyone — feeling set. I'll post my 30/60/90 draft here by Friday.
Sarah (People Ops): Perfect — I'll follow up with procurement + IT to confirm laptop ETA and check off access items. :raised_hands:
